documents.note: New Heights Move-Out Form (scan). Move-out 12/20/22, evaluation 12/21/22, deposit in escrow '$2500 (SDRP)'. Deductions: Misc. Repairs $1155 + MCF $200 = $1355.00. Accounting box: Refund $0.00, Balance Due $0.00, received 1/20/23. This is the winning document.
TnT Property Solutions invoice Meld #TW7MTLI for $1,155. Backs the 'Misc. Repairs' line and is used only to split it.
zInspector move-out report, 50 pages. Every room/system is rated S (Satisfactory) with action 'None'. No pet comments.

lease.lease_break_terms: No early-termination fee is stated in the excerpt. Military clause allows termination with orders + 30 days notice. Holdover is 2x the daily rate. reconciliation: Open lines 75+675+155+250 (TnT invoice = Misc. Repairs 1,155) + MCF 200 = 1,355.00, with no credits. This equals the Move-Out Form total of 1,355.00. The form's accounting box shows 'Balance Due $0.00', presumably because the $2,500 'SDRP' deposit is not cash and the balance is being claimed.
notes: End-of-term move-out on 12/20/22, the lease end date. No rent or fees are claimed and there is no ledger. The move-out evaluation rates every room S/None, which conflicts with the $675 patch/paint ('giant holes') and cleaning charges. The vendor invoice is the only support. TnT item 2 ($675) mixes painting/patching with bulbs, filter, trash-out and burner pans and has no split; I categorized it as painting. Deposit amount differs between documents: the lease says $2,100 and the Move-Out Form says '$2500 (SDRP)'. No pets.
